description: Convert between 24-hour (military) time and 12-hour clock time. Direction '24h-to-12h' takes a 24-hour time like '1430' or '14:30'. Direction '12h-to-24h' takes a 12-hour time like '2:30' with a meridiem of am or pm (the meridiem can also be written in the time string). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/military-time-converter/

meridiem.description: am or pm for 12h-to-24h when not in the time string (default pm)

time.description: The time to convert, e.g. '1430', '14:30', '2:30 pm'
